title: Launches open instantly on a local /new-tab page
body: Launches open instantly on a local /new-tab page (Otto + a live status strip) instead of hitting the network — works fully offline.

title: Cmd+T lands on /new-tab in every engine
body: Cmd+T (Ctrl+T) lands on /new-tab across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

title: No-argument launches auto-name and persist a profile
body: No-argument launches auto-name the browser and persist a profile from your git repo / username / .octowright config — no more random instance IDs.

title: browser_each fans one action across every browser
body: browser_each fans one action (navigate/resize/evaluate/wait_for/screenshot) across every browser at once.

title: The dashboard moved to port 6286
body: Dashboard moved to port 6286 ('OCTO'); octowright restart now rebinds in ~2s.

title: browser_click and browser_fill take ARIA locators
body: browser_click / browser_fill take ARIA locators (role/label/text/test_id) directly — the separate _by tools are gone.
